title: Khon Kaen International Marathon 2027 Review: Isan's 22nd-Edition Classic

meta_description: The Khon Kaen International Marathon returns for its 22nd edition on January 10, 2027. Full marathon, half, and 11.55K, registration now open -- northeast Thailand's longest-running marathon.
dek: The 22nd edition of the Khon Kaen International Marathon is set for 10 January 2027 in the heart of Isan — northeast Thailand's largest city. Three distances including a full marathon, and registration is already open. Here's what to expect from one of Thailand's most established regional marathons.
verdict: The Khon Kaen International Marathon has quietly built a 22-edition legacy as Isan's premier road race — the kind of regional institution that doesn't chase international headlines but delivers dependable, community-backed race-day operations year after year. Three distances (42K, 21K, and an unusual 11.55K quarter-marathon) give it a distinctive format, and the fact that registration is already open for January 2027 makes it one of the more bookable races on the early calendar. Khon Kaen itself is a genuine regional hub with an airport, a university-town atmosphere, and a cost of living that makes race weekend refreshingly affordable. Suits runners who want an established Thai marathon off the tourist trail with cool-season conditions and minimal crowds.

sections.heading: 22 Editions: Isan's Marathon Institution
paragraphs: Twenty-two editions make the Khon Kaen International Marathon one of Thailand's longest-running regional marathons — a race that has been part of the Isan sporting calendar since before the country's running boom. [1] That longevity signals deep community roots: local government support, volunteer networks that know the course by heart, and an event that's woven into the city's annual rhythm rather than dropped in by an external race operator.

sections.heading: The Format: Full, Half, and an 11.55K Quarter
paragraphs: Three distances are offered: a full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), and an 11.55km distance. [1] The 11.55K is an unusual addition — roughly a quarter-marathon — that sits between the 10K and half marathon distances most races offer. It's a distinctive touch that gives runners a stepping-stone option beyond the standard 10K.

sections.heading: Khon Kaen: Isan's Urban Hub
paragraphs: Khon Kaen is northeast Thailand's largest city and a major transport and education hub — it has an airport with direct flights from Bangkok and Chiang Mai, a large university, and a developed hotel and restaurant scene. [1] The January date catches Isan's cool, dry season, with morning temperatures in the mid-to-high teens — as comfortable as road racing gets in Thailand. The cost of accommodation and food in Khon Kaen is substantially lower than Bangkok or Phuket, making race weekend unusually affordable.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a well-established Thai marathon with 22 editions of history, cool-season Isan conditions, and registration that's open right now, the Khon Kaen International Marathon deserves a spot on your 2027 calendar. The 22nd edition is set for 10 January. Register via khonkaenmarathon.com. [1]
